notes.content:

notes.title: April 11th Update Notice
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44930579/313df55c8857b001a6f85bfe50ea1c3d78a3235c.png
"The game server will undergo maintenance at 01:00 Pacific Standard Time (PST) on April 11th, during which you will be unable to log in. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. The maintenance is expected to last for 30 minutes. If it interrupts your ongoing matches, the corresponding entry fees or tickets will be refunded.
The update includes the following:
1、New limited-time mode ""Strategy Mode"", lasts for two weeks
2、Leaderboard displays extended to top 100 positions
3、Hero ""Lan Yu"" talent ""Icy Spring"" value adjustment
4、Adjustment of card ""Overtones"" of ""Dachao Pawnshop""
5、Other minor bug fixes"

notes.title: April 9th Update Notice
notes.content:
The game server will undergo maintenance at 02:00Pacific Standard Time (PST) on April 9th, during which you will be unable to log in. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. The maintenance is expected to last for 30 minutes. If it interrupts your ongoing matches, the corresponding entry fees or tickets will be refunded.
The update includes the following:
Optimized player matchmaking mechanism.
Discounted hero rotation in the shop changed to "Kali."
Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.title: April 7th Update Notice
notes.content:
The game server will undergo maintenance at 23:30 Pacific Standard Time (PST) on April 7th, during which you will be unable to log in. We apologize for any inconvenience caused. The maintenance is expected to last for 30 minutes. If it interrupts your ongoing matches, the corresponding entry fees or tickets will be refunded.
The update includes the following:
Added new background music.
Fixed display issues with some cards.
Fixed the issue where the hero "LanYu," obtained through daily check-ins, could not be exchanged.

notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
Experience Optimization:
1、After the battle ends, players can view the deck used in the last battle on the settlement interface.
2、Pop-up notifications in the game can now be closed by clicking anywhere on the screen.
3、Hero experience vouchers have been added to the shop, allowing players to purchase them with resources obtained during battles.
Bug Fixes:
4、Fixed some content within the Tactical Center's quizzes.
5、Fixed a bug where the card "Twin Divine Lights" could be triggered infinitely.

notes.title: April 1st Update Notice
notes.content:
An update has been released for Atman:Rebel Flame:
Fixed display issues with some cards during battles.
Fixed display name issues with tutorial level names.
Fixed other issues that may affect the gaming experience.
